title: Technical integration specification - Norn Project Web 2.1.0

frozen_decisions.description: The phase 1 product is a complete loopback Web application; Tauri is excluded until phase 2.
The Web exposes Project governance and local audit/Doctor actions but no orchestration mutation.
A stable local human profile signs append-only governance events; framework documents remain immutable.
The existing execution registry and worker state remain authoritative for live observation.
One NornBridge contract isolates the renderer from HTTP and future Tauri transports.
The private mock is a visual reference only and cannot remain a generated runtime target.

nature: Hexagonal integration of new governance and presentation application capabilities with a secured local HTTP/SSE inbound adapter and a code-split React renderer packaged as static assets.

crates: domain/governance - immutable human profile snapshots, targets and governance events
application/web - Project, Feature, document, graph, governance, audit, Agent and orchestration projections
ports/outbound - governance store and change observer
adapters: filesystem - atomic preferences v2, append-only governance registry and chokidar invalidations
web server - loopback HTTP API v1, static assets, Bearer authentication, Origin/path checks and SSE
renderer - React/Vite HTTP bridge, router, accessible design system and schema-driven document view

contracts.name: NornBridge
contracts.definition: A transport-neutral typed interface for Project/Feature read models, document and graph detail, Agents, audits, governance, read-only orchestration, profile/locale preferences, Project/Feature creation, audit lifecycle and confirmed Doctor repairs. UI components import this interface only.

contracts.name: Project governance registry
contracts.definition: Portable schemaVersion 1 file at .arka-norn/governance.json containing projectId, updatedAt and append-only events. Each event has a stable id, one of six canonical kinds, exact targets, rationale/payload, actor snapshot and ISO timestamp; resolution/supersession references prior decision ids rather than rewriting records.

contracts.name: Human document presentation
contracts.definition: A safe recursive presentation tree built from validated content and schema property order. Envelope metadata is separated from semantic sections; scalar object arrays become tables, references become resolved links, unknown fields remain visible and long text renders sanitized Markdown without raw HTML.

contracts.name: Local API v1
contracts.definition: schemaVersion 2 envelopes over loopback only. An ephemeral 256-bit token is bootstrapped from the URL fragment and required as Authorization Bearer for every API/SSE request; invalid origins, paths and methods fail with stable codes.

contracts.name: Live invalidation
contracts.definition: Authenticated SSE messages contain only scope, Project/Feature/execution identifiers, revision and occurredAt. Watcher bursts debounce for 250 ms; clients always reload complete projections and reconnect with a fresh snapshot.

contracts.name: Web build
contracts.definition: Tracked source under web, filtered generated web catalogs/contracts, Vite output under dist/web, route-level code splitting, no external font/network dependency and npm packaging through the existing dist allowlist.
